title: The Frostfly That Trebles
story: In the echoing halls of the Blue Salt Caverns, one single frostfly named Nixerath hums over a frozen spring — and every time it is struck, it splits into three. Mr 6 raises his sword, then stops mid-swing and starts scratching numbers on his shield instead. "Three strikes," he mutters, "would be a blizzard."
question: If Mr 6 struck the swarm 4 times in a row, and every single frostfly present splits into 3 each time, how many frostflies would be buzzing after the fourth strike?
solution: Start with 1 frostfly; after strike 1 there are 1 * 3 = 3.
After strike 4: 27 * 3 = 81 frostflies — so Mr 6 wisely never swings.
praise: Tripling over and over was exactly the right idea — it just needed one more round of tripling to reach the fourth strike.
hint: Track it strike by strike: 1, then triple, then triple again — count how many triplings four strikes gives you.
victory: Mr 6 sheathed his sword and simply opened the cavern's warm south door. Nixerath, being a frostfly, fled the sunbeam alone and undivided — a swarm of one, defeated by arithmetic and a draft.
imagePrompt: A single shimmering ice-winged frostfly hovering above a frozen spring in a vast blue salt cavern, with a small numeral-6 knight lowering his sword and chalking multiplication on his shield.
